page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Page number at the head centre. Catchword "Dei" at the lower right. The strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: stantes objecusse periculum & se et populum suae fidei commissum, hoc uno nomine, ne parerent sedi Romanae. Resp. Id factum est, quia norunt, se Dei verbo debe-re summam fidem atq; obedientiam, & pro defensione veritatis etiā gravissima, si ita necessitas exigat, esse perferenda, ad imitationem veterum piorum, teste Historia sacra?9 Vete-rem et puriorem ecclesiam synodorum indictione, veluti praecipuo ad tollendas controversias remedio, usam fuisse : Itaque merito suspectum esse piis omnibus, quòd Protestantes parere noluerint concilio legitimè cogregato. Resp. Vetus ecclesia piarum synodorum indictione usa est ad tollendas controversias: At demonstravimus Tridentinū & cæ-tera Romanensium concilia inter pias & legitimas synodos recenseri non posse. Petierunt itaque Protestantes, atque etiam nunc petunt concilium legitimum: hoc si detur, ejus cognitioni se se, sicut decet pie subjiciunt. 10 Tridentinum illud esse ritè indictum à Pontifice Romano. Resp. At auctoritas conciliorum dependet à Dei

page.notes: The first line is at the top of the page and begins mid-paragraph, so it is marked as a continuation. The superscript numerals 9 and 10 are printed in the text, not as marginal notes. The word "stantes" at the very start is partly damaged at the left edge of the scan and is a likely reading. The hyphenated words "cæ-tera", "Vete-rem" and "debe-re" are split across line ends. The strip at the right edge of the scan belongs to the neighbouring page and was left out.
